post.text: He adopted a terrified dog locked in a cage for 4 years 😱 https://t.co/bbQy6NqWK0
post.author_description: Posting trending and viral videos around the world. Stay in the loop with what's buzzing! DM for credit or removal

description.description: A tan and white dog is seen in a metal kennel at a shelter, its eyes wide with fear. A person reaches in and gently pets its head. The dog is then shown being carried in a burgundy blanket through a parking lot.
description.ocrText:
This dog's cruel previous owner kept it locked in a small cage for four years leaving it completely terrified.
At the shelter, a kind man gently reached in to softly stroke the fearful dog's head.
He adopted the dog, wrapping it in a warm blanket to safely carry it to his car.

tweetMedia.transcription: Oh, you poor thing. You look so terrified sitting all alone in there. It's okay. I'm not going to hurt you. You're safe with me now. We are going home. No more cages for you ever again. Just a little bit further, you are doing so well on your first car ride. Take your time. Drink as much as you want, buddy. You are getting so strong. Good boy. Pull it. Get him. Pop those bubbles. Look how high you can jump. You look so handsome walking out here. What a good boy. Sweet dreams, my beautiful boy. You're safe forever now.
